papers.title: Emergence of a Symmetry-Broken Chern Insulator near a Moiré Kondo Breakdown
papers.authors: Wanghao Tian, Bowen Shen, Lizhong Li, Mingjie Zhang, Feng Liu, Chushan Li, Yaotian Liu, Fan Xu, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Peiling Li, Li Lu, Yang Xu, Shengwei Jiang, Tingxin Li, Jie Shan, Kin Fai Mak
papers.abstract: Moiré semiconductors built on angle-aligned transition metal dichalcogenide (TMD) heterobilayers provide a physical realization of the Kondo lattice model, in which one TMD layer is prepared in a Mott insulating state supporting a lattice of local magnetic moments and the other layer in a metallic state supporting itinerant carriers. The artificial Kondo lattice enables the exploration of exotic states of matter near a continuously tunable Kondo breakdown. Here we report the emergence of a symmetry-broken Chern insulator at a moiré hole filling factor 4 / 3 in angle-aligned MoTe 2 / WSe 2 moiré bilayers, which realize a chiral Kondo lattice. The symmetry-broken Chern insulator, which exhibits integer quantized Hall conductance at a fractional moiré filling, breaks the translational symmetry of the lattice spontaneously; it also appears only near a magnetic-field-induced Kondo breakdown in the mixed-valence regime of the material. We further demonstrate that the magnetic field required to induce the Kondo breakdown and to stabilize the symmetry-broken Chern insulator is twist angle dependent. The results present new opportunities for exploring the subtle interplay between topology and Kondo interactions in moiré semiconductors.
papers.summary_en: The study reports a symmetry-broken Chern insulator at moiré filling 4/3 in angle-aligned MoTe2/WSe2 bilayers, a system realizing a chiral Kondo lattice. The state occurs near magnetic-field-induced Kondo breakdown in the mixed-valence regime and its stabilizing field depends on twist angle.

papers.physics_advance: A symmetry-broken Chern insulator with integer-quantized Hall conductance emerges at fractional moiré filling near magnetic-field-induced Kondo breakdown, with its stabilization dependent on twist angle.
papers.relevance_reason: The study reports an experimentally observed symmetry-broken topological electronic state in a moiré Kondo system and links its appearance to field-induced Kondo breakdown.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在角度对准的 MoTe2/WSe2 双层中发现了莫尔填充因子 4/3 处的对称性破缺陈绝缘体；该体系实现了手性 Kondo 晶格。此态出现在混合价态区、磁场诱导的 Kondo 破缺附近，其稳定所需磁场随扭转角而变化。
papers.method_en: The work examines angle-aligned MoTe2/WSe2 moiré bilayers as a chiral Kondo lattice and tunes the moiré filling, magnetic field, and twist angle. It identifies the insulating state through its integer-quantized Hall conductance at fractional filling and relates its occurrence to Kondo breakdown.
papers.method_zh: 研究将角度对准的 MoTe2/WSe2 莫尔双层作为手性 Kondo 晶格，调节莫尔填充、磁场和扭转角。研究通过分数填充处的整数化霍尔电导识别绝缘态，并考察其与 Kondo 破缺的关联。
papers.result_en: A symmetry-broken Chern insulator emerges at moiré hole filling 4/3 and exhibits integer-quantized Hall conductance despite the fractional filling. The state spontaneously breaks lattice translational symmetry. It appears only near a magnetic-field-induced Kondo breakdown in the mixed-valence regime. The magnetic field needed both to induce Kondo breakdown and to stabilize the state depends on twist angle.
papers.result_zh: 在莫尔空穴填充因子 4/3 处出现了对称性破缺陈绝缘体，尽管填充为分数值，其霍尔电导却呈整数化。该态自发破坏晶格平移对称性。它仅出现在混合价态区磁场诱导的 Kondo 破缺附近。诱导 Kondo 破缺及稳定该态所需的磁场均取决于扭转角。
papers.future_en: A useful next step is to map how the symmetry-broken Chern state evolves across twist angle, filling, and magnetic field, particularly around the Kondo-breakdown boundary. Further work could clarify how topology and Kondo interactions are connected in this moiré setting, as suggested by the reported phase’s proximity to breakdown.
papers.future_zh: 后续可系统描绘对称性破缺陈态随扭转角、填充和磁场的演化，尤其关注 Kondo 破缺边界附近的行为。研究还可进一步阐明这一莫尔体系中的拓扑与 Kondo 相互作用如何关联；该相靠近 Kondo 破缺的特征提示了这一问题。

papers.title: Signatures of a Kondo insulator in a multilayer moiré Superlattice
papers.authors: Qiran Wu, Jingyuan Cui, Ang-Kun Wu, Yuze Meng, Dongxue Chen, Yueshan Wang, Li Yan, Lei Ma, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Shi-Zeng Lin, Su-Fei Shi, Yong-Tao Cui
papers.abstract: Abstract Kondo insulators are paradigmatic strongly correlated materials, traditionally found in f-electron compounds. They originate from the hybridization between itinerant conduction electrons and localized magnetic moments, which opens a gap in the electronic spectrum. Two-dimensional moiré systems provide a new route to flat bands with strong electron correlation, which host localized moments at half filling. Here we report signatures, based on local conductivity measurements using microwave impedance microscopy, of a Kondo insulator in a moiré superlattice of monolayer WS 2 / bilayer WSe 2 , in which one WSe 2 layer carries flat moiré bands and the other dispersive ones. When both layers are partially doped with two holes per moiré unit cell in total, an insulating state appears when the moiré band contains less than one hole. The insulator becomes metallic above a certain threshold magnetic field, evidence for the singlet nature of the Kondo insulator, and the observed behavior is reproduced by a periodic Anderson model. Our results open a route to simulating Kondo physics in tunable moiré systems.
papers.summary_en: The study reports local-conductivity signatures of a Kondo insulator in a WS2/WSe2 multilayer moiré superlattice. The insulating state occurs at a specified total doping and moiré-band occupancy, becomes metallic above a threshold magnetic field, and is reproduced by a periodic Anderson model.

papers.physics_advance: A moiré superlattice exhibits an insulating state consistent with Kondo singlet formation, which becomes metallic above a threshold magnetic field.
papers.relevance_reason: It presents experimental evidence for a Kondo-insulating state in a tunable moiré electronic system and interprets the observations with a correlated-electron model.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究在 WS2/WSe2 多层莫尔超晶格中报告了 Kondo 绝缘体的局域电导特征。该绝缘态出现在特定的总掺杂量和莫尔能带占据条件下，超过某一磁场阈值后转为金属态，且周期 Anderson 模型能够再现所观察到的行为。
papers.method_en: The authors use microwave impedance microscopy to measure local conductivity in a monolayer WS2/bilayer WSe2 moiré superlattice, where one WSe2 layer hosts flat moiré bands and the other dispersive bands. They compare the observed doping- and field-dependent behavior with a periodic Anderson model.
papers.method_zh: 作者使用微波阻抗显微术测量单层 WS2/双层 WSe2 莫尔超晶格的局域电导；其中一个 WSe2 层具有平坦莫尔能带，另一个具有色散能带。研究将观察到的掺杂依赖和磁场依赖行为与周期 Anderson 模型进行比较。
papers.result_en: Local-conductivity measurements provide signatures of a Kondo-insulating state in the multilayer moiré superlattice. With two holes per moiré unit cell in total across the partially doped layers, an insulating state appears when the moiré band contains fewer than one hole. Above a threshold magnetic field, the insulator becomes metallic, which the authors interpret as evidence for the singlet nature of the Kondo insulator. The observed behavior is reproduced by a periodic Anderson model.
papers.result_zh: 局域电导测量显示，该多层莫尔超晶格具有 Kondo 绝缘态的特征。当部分掺杂的层合计每个莫尔晶胞含两个空穴，且莫尔能带中的空穴数少于一个时，会出现绝缘态。超过某一磁场阈值后，绝缘态转为金属态；作者将此解释为 Kondo 绝缘体具有单重态性质的证据。周期 Anderson 模型能够再现所观察到的行为。
papers.future_en: Further measurements could map the insulating state across doping and magnetic field to delineate its phase boundaries and the metallic transition. The reported agreement with the periodic Anderson model also motivates additional tests of how the flat- and dispersive-band layers contribute to the observed Kondo-insulator signatures.
papers.future_zh: 后续测量可系统描绘绝缘态随掺杂和磁场的变化，以确定其相边界及金属化转变。该结果与周期 Anderson 模型相符，也促使人们进一步检验平坦能带层和色散能带层分别如何贡献于所观察到的 Kondo 绝缘体特征。

papers.title: Strain-induced correlated metallic phase in 1T-TaS2
papers.authors: Shuto Suzuki, Kosuke Nakayama, Koki Yanagizawa, Katsuaki Sugawara, Seigo Souma, Kenichi Ozawa, Shunichi Takano, Ryoga Takahara, Takeshi Hara, Yusuke Wakabayashi, Takashi Takahashi, Tsutomu Nojima, Keiji Ueno, Takafumi Sato
papers.abstract: Abstract Layered transition-metal dichalcogenide 1T-TaS 2 has long been considered a prime example of a Mott insulator driven by strong electron correlations. However, this view has been recently challenged by proposals which favor a band insulating state arising from interlayer dimerization. This ongoing debate opens a frontier in 1T-TaS 2 research focusing on stacking order, and raises a fundamental question with broad implications for two-dimensional materials: can electronic phases be engineered by actively tuning interlayer coupling? Here, using micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy supported by first-principles calculations, we demonstrate that uniaxial strain drives 1T-TaS 2 from its insulating charge-density-wave phase into a stable metallic phase. This metallic phase, distinct from hydrostatic-pressure-induced or non-equilibrium hidden phases, emerges via a strain-induced rearrangement in the interlayer stacking of the Star-of-David charge order, effectively disrupting interlayer dimerization. Furthermore, the emergent metallic phase exhibits a significant quasiparticle mass renormalization, a hallmark of strong electron correlations, indicating its correlated nature and proximity to a Mott instability. This finding necessitates a re-evaluation of the interplay between structural and strong correlations in 1T-TaS 2 . The present results establish uniaxial strain as a powerful method for tuning the interlayer coupling, opening pathways for exploring quantum phases inaccessible under ambient conditions.
papers.summary_en: The study finds that uniaxial strain drives 1T-TaS2 from its insulating charge-density-wave phase into a stable correlated metallic phase. The metallic state is associated with rearranged Star-of-David stacking that disrupts interlayer dimerization and has strongly renormalized quasiparticle mass.

papers.physics_advance: Uniaxial strain rearranges the Star-of-David stacking in 1T-TaS2, disrupts interlayer dimerization, and produces a correlated metallic phase with substantial quasiparticle mass renormalization.
papers.relevance_reason: This combines spectroscopy and calculations to establish a strain-tuned, strongly correlated electronic phase in a layered quantum material.
papers.summary_zh: 该研究发现，单轴应变可使 1T-TaS2 从电荷密度波绝缘相转变为稳定的关联金属相。该金属态与 Star-of-David 电荷序堆垛重排及层间二聚化受破坏有关，并具有显著的准粒子质量重整化。
papers.method_en: The authors use micro-focused angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to examine 1T-TaS2 under uniaxial strain, supported by first-principles calculations. They compare the resulting phase with pressure-induced and non-equilibrium hidden metallic phases discussed in the abstract.
papers.method_zh: 作者利用微区角分辨光电子能谱研究单轴应变下的 1T-TaS2，并以第一性原理计算提供支持。摘要还将所得相与压力诱导金属相及非平衡隐藏相作了区分。
papers.result_en: Uniaxial strain drives 1T-TaS2 from its insulating charge-density-wave phase into a stable metallic phase. This phase is distinct from the metallic phases induced by hydrostatic pressure or found in non-equilibrium hidden states. It emerges alongside a strain-induced rearrangement of Star-of-David charge-order stacking that disrupts interlayer dimerization. The metal exhibits significant quasiparticle mass renormalization, which the authors identify as a hallmark of strong correlations and proximity to a Mott instability.
papers.result_zh: 单轴应变使 1T-TaS2 从电荷密度波绝缘相转变为稳定金属相。该相不同于静水压力诱导的金属相，也不同于非平衡隐藏态。其出现伴随着应变引起的 Star-of-David 电荷序堆垛重排，从而破坏层间二聚化。该金属相具有显著的准粒子质量重整化；作者将其视为强关联及接近 Mott 不稳定性的标志。
papers.future_en: Further work could map the strain dependence of the stacking rearrangement and metallic state, and test how robust the correlated metal is across strain conditions. The reported results also motivate closer examination of how interlayer coupling and electronic correlations jointly shape the phases of 1T-TaS2.
papers.future_zh: 后续研究可绘制堆垛重排与金属态随应变变化的相图，并检验关联金属在不同应变条件下的稳定性。该结果也促使人们进一步考察层间耦合与电子关联如何共同决定 1T-TaS2 的相态。
